profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Getty Images
profile.summary:
A full-stack developer and former systems administrator. I'm always looking for the next challenge:

- TypeScript/JavaScript
- React/Redux
- Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software developer for the Radiology Department, developing web applications with Ruby on Rails, PHP, and Java. I also occasionally work on side-projects, such as developing storage device plugins, iOS applications, and Slack bots.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Ruby on Rails, PHP, Wordpress, iOS developer for hire.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Developed cbmint.com site using PHP in Magento.
Developed the CBMint iOS application.

positions.title: Lead Systems Administrator
positions.description:
● Supported Neustar's global DNS infrastructure.
● Designed and implemented critical application monitors
● Designed and implemented an automation and configuration management infrastructure using Puppet, Fabric, Cobbler and other tools.

positions.title: Senior Systems Administrator
positions.description:
●	Designed, built and maintained a computing infrastructure for about 50 scientists.
●	Implemented file services, backups, print services, monitoring, computing clusters, compute servers.
●	Automated configuration management for workstations and servers. Automated the installation of every workstation. Provided web services and virtualized hosts where appropriate.
●	Supervised and mentored a Junior Systems Administrator. 
●	Advised and supported scientists and departmental administrators about computing needs and infrastructure.
